item.g:title: Impulse Anvil - Impulse-Response Design Workstation & Convolution VST3 for Windows
item.g:short_title: Design New Impulse Responses from Two Sources
item.g:description: Impulse Anvil is a Windows 10/11 64-bit VST3 impulse-response design workstation. Load two IRs, recordings or found sounds, shape A and B, choose from 21 Morph relationships, author movement and source-time with Draw, Path, Glue Path and Omni Path, audition through convolution, then Bake reusable WAV impulse responses. The full license includes the complete Morph library, two Color rows, Texture Depth, editing, visual EQ, Focus View, the IR Browser, global Undo/Redo, WAV baking, 126 included IRs and two license seats.
item.g:product_type: Audio Software > Audio Plugins > Convolution & Impulse Response Tools
item.g:product_highlight: Build new impulse responses from two IRs, recordings or found sounds.
21 Morph relationships across Core Morph, Residual / Decompose and Acoustic Interaction.
Author A/B movement and source-time with Draw, Path, Glue Path and Omni Path.
Bake designed results as reusable standard WAV impulse responses.
Focus View, IR Browser, Morph Browser and global Undo / Redo support deeper exploration.
Windows 10/11 64-bit VST3 with 126 included IRs and two activation seats.
